source_text: In Kenya and Tanzania, for instance, school-based demand creation through peer education and media campaigns complemented clinic services, while South Africa and Zambia employed task-shifting to nurse-led procedures to address physician shortages, enabling over 80% of circumcisions by non-doctors without increased adverse events.
